ATX closed heading style adds closing hashes

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, HeadingStyle

def main() -> None:
    html = "<h1>Closed Heading</h1>"
    options = ConversionOptions(heading_style=HeadingStyle("AtxClosed"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
